Q9029.reason: Water is hypotonic, so absorption through the bladder or a breached mucosa can cause hemolysis and dilutional electrolyte imbalance such as hyponatremia.

Q9030.reason: The son is a donee beneficiary whose rights had not vested before he learned of the contract, so the owner and landscaper could still validly modify the payee term.

Q9031.reason: Under UCC 2-210, a general ban on assignment of the contract is read as barring only delegation, so the right to receive payment can still be assigned unless the clause clearly says otherwise.
